logical_operator_reconstruction_rows.residual_gap: Logical operators may reconstruct exactly on different regions in different sectors without one operational channel. logical_operator_reconstruction_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer that multiple reconstructions duplicate a system, that a boundary/logical representation is the same ontology, or that a logical operator has become a candidate-native public observable without the quotient and decoder rows.
